name: Gorgoroth
description:
'''Gorgoroth''' is a Norwegian [[black metal]] band based in [[Bergen (city)|Bergen]]. It was formed in 1992 by guitarist [[Infernus]], the sole original member remaining. They have released nine studio albums. Gorgoroth are a [[Satanism|Satanic]] band and have drawn controversy due to some of their concerts featuring impaled sheep heads and mock crucifixions. The band is named after the dead [[plateau]] of darkness in the land of [[Mordor]] from [[J. R. R. Tolkien]]'s ''[[The Lord of the Rings]]''.
